issues.detail: Any entity list payload or block entity NBT/state is refused before plan/build. No silent discard, entity duplication, inventory or BE restoration claim.
Actual distinct-process clean interrupted restart passes; forced kill, save-lag fault injection and hardware powerloss remain unverified. Atomic file force does not establish ACID.
Production command gate refuses additional mod IDs beyond Minecraft/Forge/self. No adapter for third-party claims or direct operator commands.

Only accepted unchanged s8_05 and s8_06 architectural normal rooms. No entrance/treasure/combat semantics; other biomes deferred. Runtime doorway sealing is an adapted candidate, not an assertion that old room acceptance covers final assembly.

Uses real core blockPosition unit-cube offset and exteriorFeet/worldPort intervals. Forge registry tests cover all4 rotations and actual world test reads all cells, door/collision/floor route for exercised layout.

Real server rejected mature amethyst_cluster inherited randomTick flag although datagen cache did not. javap audit confirms no randomTick override on AmethystClusterBlock/AmethystBlock; narrow mature-cluster exception only, no budding or buds. World tests pass without global gamerule changes.

Reobfuscated JAR built and archive audited. Source-run actual Forge tests use the compiled production classes, not installed release artifact. Integration should independently rerun/install only in its isolated test environment.
